youtube_title: Last Year's TOP Fund? Only 21% Stay on Top 🏆 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Guess: today's top fund, what are the odds it stays on top?

FundsIndia checked equity mutual funds that were in the top 25% over 5 years: only 21% stayed in the top 25% over the next 5 years. Last year's winner often just rode one hot sector.

Rule: check 5-10 year consistency, the expense ratio and your own goal, not the 1-year rank.
Moral: Yesterday's topper isn't always tomorrow's topper.

Source: FundsIndia Wealth Conversations report (Oct 2026), as reported by 5paisa.
Education only, not investment advice. No fund recommended.
